overview: The Climate Equity Council met to review progress on municipal climate initiatives, upcoming outreach events, and council priorities for the coming year. The council approved the June meeting minutes and rescheduled its August meeting.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the meeting minutes from June.

items.title: Meeting Scheduling and Administrative Updates
items.summary: The council rescheduled its August meeting to August 23 and received an update on four new Tufts University interns supporting local greenhouse gas tracking and festival planning.

items.title: Community Outreach and Events Calendar
items.summary: Members coordinated outreach and tabling opportunities at upcoming events, including the Electrify Medford kickoff, the Brazilian Festival, and the Medford Farmers Market.

items.title: Electrify Medford Program Updates
items.summary: Brenda Pike reported that 16 residents have enrolled, 12 volunteer coaches have finished training, and program materials and intake forms are being translated into multiple languages.

items.title: Curbside Composting, Fleet Electrification, and School HVAC
items.summary: Staff noted that curbside composting signups surpassed 4,000 households, charging stations at the police station went live, and designers completed a walkthrough assessment for the McGlynn and Andrews school HVAC upgrades.

items.title: Energy and Environment Committee Report
items.summary: Brenda Pike summarized recent Energy and Environment Committee activities, including a residential heat pump tour, rain garden restoration at Wright's Pond, and a potential CPA funding application to study invasive plants.

items.title: Council Annual Priorities
items.summary: Members discussed and assigned names to primary council goals, selecting urban tree canopy expansion, extreme heat vulnerability, cooling center access, and public transit as focal areas.

items.title: Future Meeting Topics and Adjournment
items.summary: The council proposed inviting the city tree warden and scheduling an Electrify Medford training session for a future meeting before voting to adjourn.
